Name: Stardew Valley - Roguelike
Author: TheTrain2000
Description:
[size=5]Welcome to The Abyss![/size]

With this mod we bring a new experience to Stardew Valley. Explore and fight your way through an infinitely deep mine. Are you able to reach the bottom? Can you reach the bottom faster than everyone else?

[b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*][size=2]10 unique boss fights[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Custom floor layouts[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Floors with unique challenges[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Custom in-game perks and curses[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Difficulty scaling and hard mode[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Multiplayer and split-screen support[/size][/*]
[/list]
